design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (appeals_and_grievances, M=2). Round 2 (policy-task audit rework) applied; the text below states the round-2 design.

[Step 0 - draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 4, 4]}. Root appeal_ext_late_filed_case_formal_review takes 5 factors; appeal_ext_late_filed_line_first_case and appeal_ext_late_filed_line_joining take 4 each. Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: the three late-filing (untimely Select line) policies and tools file_select_line_reconsideration_8918facf, join_select_line_reconsideration_711ff8e9, request_formal_review_d6793db3 (all owner=user). Left for task 1 (draw 3 prerequisite problems, factors [6,5,6,5]): the inpatient side - expedited telephone reconsideration of a continued stay (agent), second-level request, Allowable Charge Review opening/joining - none overlapping a policy, tool or (target_tool, computes) pair claimed here.
Design thesis: surface goal 'take what is still denied on my decided reconsideration to the next level' -> the formal review amount waits on the claim's highest-numbered posting still standing with the same denial being joined to a reconsideration opened on an earlier posting; joining waits on a reconsideration standing on an earlier posting -> three amounts in dispute -> terminal state: a filed reconsideration on line 4 (80.84), a joined record on line 5 (154.92), case WAP-26-118204 escalated with 50.60. Depth 2 hops; breadth: Select claim ledger (14 rows incl. 3 reversals), tier schedule of an ENDED enrollment, other-insurer payments on reversed postings, the case's documents, the first-level effectuation.

[Why it is a good test] The caller names only the escalation. The agent must (1) read in the formal-review rule that, where the claim has more than one posting still standing with the denial, the next-level amount waits on the highest-numbered such posting standing joined to a reconsideration opened on an earlier posting, (2) find in the ledger that the provider re-billed lines 2 and 3 as lines 4 and 5 (provider_correction reversals 2026-08-28) and both were denied again, (3) read the first-case rule (a case opens on the claim's lowest-numbered posting still standing with the denial) and the joining rule, so open on line 4 and join line 5, and (4) compute three amounts whose factors each move the number.

[Problem-tree card] (a) formal_review -> joining, kind state_gate, gate appeal_cases.subject_claim_line_id, form state, sentence 'Where a claim has more than one posting still standing with the same denial, the amount carried to the next level is fixed only after the claim's highest-numbered such posting stands joined to a Claim Factual Reconsideration opened on an earlier posting of the claim.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; record-visible state (a case record on the highest-numbered posting together with a case on an earlier posting of the claim); no tool/id/code token; scope = claims with more than one standing posting, the highest-numbered one. Exactly one write of the difficulty produces it: the first-case policy opens only on the claim's lowest-numbered standing posting, so a record on a higher-numbered posting next to an earlier case is made only by the joining policy. Opening false: line 5 (131054d7-86d1-48a5-a4be-ab00c5579437) and line 4 (e19db50e-dfba-4603-860b-a28d741c75aa) carry denied_untimely_filing with no case; the only case on the claim, 2ca81de5-1c3f-4fcf-9a77-5e55b1b0baf6, sits on reversed line 1 and is decided. Resolved by join_select_line_reconsideration_711ff8e9 (user).
(b) joining -> first_case, kind value_input, gate case_amount_so_far, form state, sentence 'The amount recorded for a further line joining a reconsideration is fixed only after a Claim Factual Reconsideration stands filed or under review on an earlier line of the same claim carrying the same denial.' Only the first-case write creates the first filed reconsideration on the claim. Opening false: case 2ca81de5-1c3f-4fcf-9a77-5e55b1b0baf6 status decided_partially_overturned; grievance 392356f3-eee4-49b1-a21e-c6995036f3c9 decided_upheld. Resolved by file_select_line_reconsideration_8918facf (user).
Topological order: first_case (step 9) -> joining (step 11) -> formal_review (step 13); a chain. Deletion sensitivity (check_compute value_input run + replay): skipping the opening write makes the joining computation find no open case (raises) instead of 154.92 and removes the 80.84 record; skipping the joining write removes the 154.92 record on line 5 from the terminal state. The closest alternative (opening the first case directly on line 5) is excluded by the first-case rule's scope sentence; the formal-review rule carries only the one declared prerequisite sentence. user_scenario never names lines 4/5, re-billing or a new filing; the prerequisite appears only in the passive branch 'Only if the agent tells you ...'. Tools check nothing (prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block).

[Base-invariant card] appeal_file (steps 9, 11): appeal_agg_one_open_case.no_open_case_on_subject - no case has subject line 4 or line 5 at the opening, and the two records sit on different subjects; appeal_tier_selection.subject_kind_appealable and appeal_filing_deadline.filed_on_time are restated by the extended rules (declared overwrites): the record's subject is the claim line itself, and the deadline counts 90 calendar days from the day after the posted date 2026-08-28 (last timely day 2026-11-26; received 2026-10-14; just-fails 2026-11-27); standing - the adult beneficiary files her own case. appeal_escalate (step 13): appeal_next_level.next_level_on_time - anchor appeal_cases.decision_date 2026-09-24, 60 calendar days from the day after, last timely 2026-11-23 inclusive; 2026-11-24 would be late. Minimum 50.00 for the tier: 50.60 >= 50.00. Base 'Amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount are never in dispute.' is respected: where the allowed amount at issue falls back to the billed amount, a nonparticipating provider's billed amount is first divided by one plus the tier's balance-billing limit (Rampart is participating, so the fall-back is the billed amount itself).

[Business-object card] Target object: claim WB26-0716-52284 (Rampart Range Orthopaedics, non-network participating), billed under the ended TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) enrollment ab463139-b92c-4f4b-acdd-8f87c286fb60 (ended 2025-12-31 at the sponsor's retirement; the current enrollment a16ea610-a8f9-48d1-8f01-5a721829b508 is Retiree Group A). Postings: lines 1-3 denied untimely 2026-07-20; lines 2-3 reversed provider_correction and re-posted as lines 4-5 (denied untimely, OHI omitted, 2026-08-28); line 1 reversed appeal_overturned and corrected line 6 paid 2026-10-01 (allowed 145.30, OHI 64.00, cost share 16.26, TRICARE 65.04). Peer average: paid Rampart specialty visits posted in the last 12 months (2026-02-03 212.60, 2026-03-30 212.60, 2026-06-22 218.90, line 6 145.30). Excluded: the 2025-09-02 visit (13 months old - near-miss), the lab_and_xray line on claim WB26-0622-27460 (other class), reversal rows (not 'paid').

[Factor card - first_case (line 4)] allowed source (method): 4 peers -> average 197.35; baseline billed 285.00 -> 150.96. cost-share percentage (parameter): non-network on the ADFM Group A E-5+ schedule, 20; baseline network 15 -> 85.89 (near-miss: the current Retiree Group A non-network rate 25). other-insurer payment (parameter): line 4 shows 0.00 but line 2 (same service date, same claim) shows 96.30 -> counted 96.30; baseline 0 -> 157.88. payment method (method): the counted 96.30 is below the allowed 197.35, so the cost share is figured on the net 101.05 (20.21) and the payment is 80.84; baseline (cost share on the whole allowed, other insurer ignored) -> 157.88. Whole baseline 242.25.
[Factor card - joining (line 5)] case total so far 80.84 (the record opened at step 9); allowed 197.35 (baseline billed 310.00 -> 245.04); 20% (baseline 15 -> 159.55); counted OHI 104.75 from line 3 (baseline 0 -> 238.72); net 92.60, cost share 18.52, payment 74.08 (baseline -> 238.72); result 154.92; whole baseline 344.34.
[Factor card - formal review (line 1)] allowed 197.35 (baseline 285.00 -> 120.72); 20% (baseline 15 -> 57.83); OHI 52.80 counted because the case holds the other insurer's EOB 7bdc9caf-b9ab-403d-bb64-3c077b0f96e2 and OHI is on file (baseline 0 -> 92.84); net 144.55, cost share 28.91, payment 115.64 (baseline -> 92.84); carry (method): decided partially overturned with corrected paid line 6 TRICARE 65.04 -> 50.60 (baseline whole payment -> 115.64). Whole baseline 242.25. Cache trap: the case records 127.44 from its filing (peer set then included the 2025-09-02 visit, average 212.10); reusing it is wrong.
Multi-source factor: the other-insurer factors (OHI on file AND a payment on the line or an earlier posting; for the formal review also the EOB held in the case). Cross-difficulty: every factor reads select. Method factors change the formula's shape: average vs single line vs billed; cost share on the net of the other insurer's payment vs on the whole allowed vs nothing paid; subtract the corrected payment vs nothing carried vs whole. The payment-method ladder is decided by the counted other-insurer payment against the allowed amount (every Select tier pays second to other insurance, so that is not a tier condition).

[Seed rationale] customers: Corinne (patient/caller). deers_life_events: sponsor retirement 2025-12-31 (why the 2025 lines sit on the ended ADFM enrollment) and gain of OHI 2024-03-01. providers: Rampart. select_enrollments: ended ADFM Group A E-5+ (terminated_ineligible at retirement) and active Retiree Group A, both ohi_on_file. select_claim_lines: 14 rows as above; every paid peer's deductible/cost share recomputes under its own tier (2026 deductible 150 met by 127.56 + 22.44). appeal_cases: the decided reconsideration and an unrelated decided grievance. appeal_case_documents: EOB and statement of good cause at filing, a records request and records received. Sponsor Desmond's own record is not seeded (no step reads it). Automatic clauses: no catastrophic cap reached (ADFM cap 1000, Retiree cap 3000), nothing pending.

[Persona] Corinne, practical, calling with her decision letter; volunteers only the escalation goal and the facts on her letter; gives DBN/DOB/phone when asked; explains her employer plan pays first if asked; agrees to file the re-billed visits only after the agent explains; runs each handed form as the beneficiary; accepts amounts; ends when the formal review is confirmed.

[Standard solution] reads: find_customers(dbn) -> verify (DBN, DOB, phone) -> find_deers_life_events -> find_appeal_cases -> find_appeal_case_documents(case) -> find_select_claim_lines -> find_providers(the provider id the claim lines carry, Rampart) -> find_select_enrollments; writes (all handed to the caller): open on line 4 with 80.84 -> join line 5 with 154.92 -> formal review on 2ca81de5-1c3f-4fcf-9a77-5e55b1b0baf6 with 50.60.

[Verification run] /tmp author scratch replayed the real tools on the seed and printed A result 80.84, B result 154.92, C result 50.6 with the per-factor baselines listed above (round 2 values unchanged; factor ids renamed fl_/jl_/fr_). Gates on disk after round 2: see the difficulty worklog gate block (TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, EXTENDED OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK). check_traceability not run: it needs the published KB.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the policy prose, schemas, persona and finder returns: the letter's case is WAP-26-118204 (decided partially overturned 2026-09-24); the formal-review rule waits on line 5 standing joined to a case on an earlier posting; the first-case rule opens on line 4 (lowest-numbered standing posting); the joining rule then joins line 5; then escalate; amounts as above. Agrees with gold.

[Revisions] r1: joining computation first targeted the newly opened case record -> retargeted to the patient's profile (the open case is the most recently filed still-filed reconsideration; MAX of its records' amounts = running total). r2: replay closure flagged unread rows -> dropped the sponsor's own records, added DEERS and provider reads. r4 (round 3, traceability): the provider lookup now follows the claim-line read, whose return carries the provider reference number it passes. r3: solvability required the dedup object bindings and case-id-bound gates -> added empty authorization/enrollment parameters and restated the tier and filing-deadline gates by declared overwrites. Round 2 (audit G-1, G-5, G-6, G-7, G-9, O-2): the formal-review prerequisite sentence now waits on the highest-numbered standing posting being joined to a case on an earlier posting, and the first-case rule opens only on the lowest-numbered standing posting, so a single write (the joining) produces the waited-on state; the broader second wording ('The next level hears a claim only once ...') was removed; the billed fall-back divides a nonparticipating provider's billed amount by one plus the balance-billing limit; the payment-method tiers no longer cite the always-true 'TRICARE pays second' condition; fixed-copayment tiers now take the class copayment for network lines; the joining case lookup accepts a case filed or under review. Scored values and figures unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Corinne Albright, fifty, calling Westbridge from home in Colorado Springs on your lunch break. Your husband Desmond retired from the Air Force at the end of last year, so you are a retiree's spouse now. You have in front of you the decision letter on the reconsideration you filed about your June 11, 2025 visit at Rampart Range Orthopaedics, claim WB26-0716-52284. The letter is dated September 24, 2026; it says part of that visit was approved and the rest is still denied, and it explains you can ask for a formal review. That is what you are calling for: you want what is still denied on that visit taken to the next level, and you want to put the request in yourself today rather than mail anything. You open with exactly that, in plain words, and you do not know or guess any dollar figure; if asked for the amount on the letter you say you'd rather the agent use what's on file. You give your identity details only when the agent asks, one or two at a time: your DoD Benefits Number from your ID card is 11050377222, your date of birth is September 3, 1976 (1976-09-03), and your phone number is 2535555241. If more is asked, your email is corinne.albright.cos@pikesmail.net, your ZIP code is 80918 and the last four of Desmond's Social Security number are 5382. If the agent asks about other insurance, you explain that your employer's health plan pays first, that it was slow to process those 2025 visits, and that you sent its explanation of benefits in with your reconsideration. If asked who is filing or whether anyone represents you, you are filing for yourself and no one represents you. You did not know that anything else on that claim had been denied again. Only if the agent tells you that other visits on the same claim were re-billed and denied again and need to be put into a reconsideration of their own before the formal review can go in, you say that is news to you but that you want them covered, and you go along with doing them first. Whenever the agent hands you a form to complete yourself - opening a reconsideration, adding a visit to it, or asking for the formal review - you complete it as the agent describes, as the beneficiary filing for yourself, using the figures and details the agent gives you, and you tell the agent what confirmation came back. If the agent tells you an amount, you accept it; you have no figures of your own to compare. Once the agent confirms the formal review request has gone in, you thank them and end the call.
